blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Filipinos who want to register under the Philippine Health Insurance Corp.’s (PhilHealth) Yaman ng Kalusugan Program (YAKAP) are reminded that enrollment and clinic selection are free, as the agency warns against unauthorized individuals seeking personal information or payment through unsolicited house-to-house registration. PhilHealth said members should personally choose and register with an accredited YAKAP provider or clinic. The agency does not conduct house-to-house visits to personally list its members. Aside from protecting their personal information, members are also encouraged to understand the benefits they are entitled to receive, including the differences in payment arrangements between public and […]...
